lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Mountain Village Town Council's October 15 meeting, where second reading of an ordinance restructuring MVHA fees — and a resolution setting the actual 2027 fee schedules for Village Court and other deed-restricted housing — are both up for a vote. Tuesday is also packed: Telluride's Town Council runs a three-hour budget work session on enterprise funds, open space, and affordable housing, while the Ouray County Commissioners take up a Special Use Permit amendment, an affordable-housing commitment under Prop 123, and a new intergovernmental law-enforcement agreement. The Telluride Horror Show lands Friday at the Sheridan Opera House, with a public hearing on the alcohol permits for that already cleared earlier in the week.
